title: Minimal Polynomial vs Characteristic Polynomial Reduction
description: Formalizes the relationship between reducing polynomials mod the minimal vs characteristic polynomial of a matrix, proving minpoly divides charpoly, degree comparisons, and introducing non-derogatory matrices.

keyInsights.title: Minpoly Divides Charpoly
keyInsights.description: By Cayley-Hamilton, charpoly annihilates M. By minimality of minpoly, minpoly divides any annihilating polynomial. Hence minpoly | charpoly.

keyInsights.title: Efficiency of Minpoly Reduction
keyInsights.description: Reducing mod minpoly gives degree < deg(minpoly) ≤ deg(charpoly) = n. When minpoly has strictly lower degree (derogatory case), minpoly reduction produces shorter results.

keyInsights.title: Non-Derogatory Characterization
keyInsights.description: A matrix is non-derogatory when deg(minpoly) = deg(charpoly). For such matrices, the reductions are equally efficient. Companion matrices are the canonical non-derogatory examples.

openQuestion: What is the relationship between reducing by the minimal polynomial vs the characteristic polynomial?
